items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Because the fad comes in with Cab Calloway, Noble Sisle, and Sunshine Sammy and -- what was this fellow's name -- Baron Lee, and all these fellows.

ctx.x: So I agreed with him and I stood up. And from then on, by travelling, I never got any chance to practice. And I began to get rusty on my instrument. After awhile, I just cut out the solos. You see, altogether. And just went on, which was pretty good, as a band conductor standing up.
And then, band conductors got obsolete -- musician band conductors. Because the fad comes in with Cab Calloway, Noble Sisle, and Sunshine Sammy and -- what was this fellow's name --
